**One design concern carried to the planner (not a user question).** Grounded
pre-plan probe: `tick_triage.ISSUE_TERMINAL` =
`{completed, archived, awaiting_promotion, blocked, on_hold}` returns
`TERMINAL` / `GATE-TRANSITION`, and both verdicts run CRON-TEARDOWN and END THE

45-min `/issue-tick <N>` cron at dispatch exactly as Step 0/6d.2 sessions do")
would, on the actual incident, have fired once within ~45-50 min, emitted one

coverage, plus a false sense of one. Inline/override rounds normally run on
exactly these park/terminal-status parents, so this is the dominant case, not
an edge.

The plan therefore delivers the task's INTENT (a real session-survival backstop
for inline/override rounds that dispatch work outliving the turn) with a
status-conditional mechanism, rather than the literal instruction. Assumption
stated in plan §1; the critic is the check on it.
